name: Stüssy
why: Shawn Stussy’s surf-shop signature on a tee in Laguna Beach became the first streetwear brand; still sells tees, sweats and jackets from four US chapter stores.
origin: Founded in an unrecorded year in Laguna Beach, California by Shawn Stussy.

notes.craft: Thread proposed 1 (10 Oct 2026): Every one of ~45 product pages opened and ~150 feed descriptions reads "Imported" with no country, maker or mill; the only sourcing words are generic ("Italian cotton canvas", "Japanese cotton twill"). craft_evidence.owned: NONE found: no factory, mill or workshop claimed on stussy.com (legal page names only Stussy Inc., 17426 Daimler St, Irvine CA — an office/operations address, not a making facility; evidence of absence, not of ownership)
craft_evidence.makers: NONE: no PDP read names a maker; co-brands (Junya Watanabe, Our Legacy Work Shop) are collaboration partners, not named makers
craft_evidence.mills: NONE: generic origin only ("Italian cotton canvas" Duster Coat, "Italian wool" Wool Varsity Jacket, "12oz Japanese cotton twill" Uniform Pant, "Italian majo-tech soft shell"); no mill named
craft_evidence.heritage: NONE on pages read: no dated/placed founding story found on stussy.com (no about page; Chapter Directory and news have none). "Laguna 80 Jersey" product name alludes only. Founding facts come from pre
craft_evidence.process: Spec-level only (claim): fabric weights and finishes on PDPs, e.g. "5.6oz pigment dyed cotton", "14oz rinsed denim", "9-gauge knit", "individually dyed" garment-dye note; no account of how or where it
